output.reason: On its own, the bullet [ev-85b9d4e4ea7d] only names the metric. The section heading it sits under [ev-1f419676f177] says what happens to it: in 3.0.0, Loki metrics that started with `cortex_` will start with `loki_` instead. So the subject is the metric `cortex_frontend_query_range_duration_seconds_sum`, and the change is a rename to `loki_frontend_query_range_duration_seconds_sum`. The same text says who is exposed: installs left on the default `metrics_namespace` of `loki`, because setting it to `cortex` keeps the old prefix. That setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. The text never says what breaks, but it follows directly from the rename: anything still querying the old `cortex_` name stops finding this series.
